name: P31 Loom
description: The design system as a live graph. Human and agent, co-present.

actions.name: loom.traverse
actions.description: Agent-side verb, not a UI affordance. The agent moves from one graph node to another. Never appears as a data-agent-action in the DOM; the agent commits it directly to the log.

actions.name: loom.propose
actions.description: Agent-side verb, not a UI affordance. The agent formalizes an idea as a proposal the human can then approve or defer. Never appears as a data-agent-action in the DOM; the agent commits it directly to the log.

actions.name: artifact.tap
actions.description: The child taps the artifact they made in Chapter 5 (the Workshop). Commits a human focus event on 'artifact'. Purely celebratory proof the artifact is alive — no state change.

actions.name: chapter.sound.toggle
actions.description: Flip the opt-in sound preference for the child-facing chapters. Device-local (localStorage), never committed to the log. Sound is off by default; this is the only way it turns on.

actions.name: chapter.workshop.open
actions.description: The hand-off from Chapter 5's workshop threshold into the full instrument. Commits a human focus event on 'workshop-open', then the shell switches mode. The door opens only when the child taps it — no auto-advance.

actions.name: color.pick
actions.description: The child picks a color in Chapter 4 (You have an idea). Commits a human focus event on the color node, then Lumi formalizes it as an agent proposal. The pick is the child's idea made concrete.

actions.name: color.repick
actions.description: Return from Lumi's review to the color picker in Chapter 4. A reversal, not a rejection — commits a human focus event on 'color-picker'. Fully reversible; a new pick produces a new proposal, never a duplicate for the same color.

actions.name: companion.back
actions.description: Return to the previous screen in the companion view. On the first screen, exits to the launchpad. Commits a human focus event on 'companion-back-{screen}'. Every companion screen has a visible Back.

actions.name: companion.next
actions.description: Advance to the next screen in the companion view ('Show me'). Commits a human focus event on 'companion-next-{screen}'. Never auto-advances; nothing moves without a tap.

actions.name: companion.view
actions.description: The companion view region — the 70-year-old's window into the log. Informational marker, not an action an agent should invoke on its own; it exists so the region is discoverable.

actions.name: make.confirm
actions.description: The child accepts Lumi's offer to make their idea ('Yes, make it') in Chapter 4. Commits a human approve event on Lumi's proposal. The child's own decision, so no confirmation is required.

actions.name: proposal.approve
actions.description: The child accepts Lumi's proposal in Chapter 3 ('Yes, do it'). Commits a human approve event. The proposal becomes real only on this event.

actions.name: proposal.defer
actions.description: The child declines Lumi's proposal for now ('Not yet') in Chapter 3. Commits a human reject event with reason 'not-yet'. A valid decision, not a failure — no retry, no re-prompt.

actions.name: theme.cycle
actions.description: Cycle the shell's theme in the top bar. Presentation-layer only (localStorage), never committed to the log. Purely cosmetic; safe to invoke.
